name: Symbolon — the twelvefold spine
description: The eight determination roots in spine order (−/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0), the four heads as traversal scenes (Mono/Poly, #, Self-Identity, Subject-Logics), and the spine-index mandala. Bound to submission-package/essay/symbolon @ dbf3b17; claim bands per record (mono-poly: Argued; all others Derived).

scenes.name: The Slash — / = −/−
scenes.character: Two dashes, one stroke: relation before named terms.

scenes.name: 0/1 — The First Orientation
scenes.character: Ground and mark in their first orientation: One through All.

scenes.name: ?/! — Question and Assertion
scenes.character: Inquiry and naming in one sign; the four corners and their SILENCE.

scenes.name: −/+ — Negation and Affirmation
scenes.character: Withdrawal and extension, reserve and issue; the field breathes.

text.title: The relation has taken a direction

scenes.name: X/x — Determining Capacity and Its Particular
scenes.character: One letter in two cases; the instance multiplies.

scenes.name: AM/IS — The Personed Copula
scenes.character: First-person presence and third-person sayability; the slash is the second person.

scenes.name: ∞/dx — Horizon and Differential
scenes.character: The horizon no finite mark contains; the differential through which relation becomes exact.

entities.name: the first lobe of the horizon
the second lobe of the horizon

scenes.name: 1/0 — The Determination Returns
scenes.character: The same relation from its other end: the mark returns toward its condition.

text.title: A determination returns with something to return

scenes.name: Mono/Poly — One through the Many
scenes.character: The One at centre; the many held around it — mutually implicate accountings, not rival totals.

scenes.name: Complexio Oppositorum — #
scenes.character: The # mark: the whole determining relation, followed through every station.

entities.name: the first vertical of the sign
the second vertical of the sign
the first horizontal of the sign
the second horizontal of the sign

text.title: The whole becomes articulate by differentiating

scenes.name: Self-Identity
scenes.character: The same appears twice, and the relation identifies them.

entities.name: the first bar of the relation
the second bar of the relation

scenes.name: Eight Determinations — The Complete Traversal
scenes.character: The spine held within the whole: centre threshold, four cardinal stations, thresholds bracketing on the rim.

text.title: One relation traversed from threshold to return
